_doc: The Main workflow's spec (D6c, 2026-10-27): its committed export is n8n/workflow.main.sanitized.json, listed with its workflow id in scripts/check-exports-parity.sh's WORKFLOWS (read through scripts/workflows.py). The export is the reference for name, nodes, connections and settings; this file holds only what the export cannot: the settings a live workflow may carry beyond its export. The migration-era fields (original, nodes, trigger, temp_trigger) went with the copy↔original pairing.

binaryMode.ruling: D6c (Yigitcan, 2026-10-26): the running Main carries binaryMode "separate" since an editor save (2026-10-26); the public API ignores binaryMode on create and update (measured, D3c), n8n does not version settings, and every binaryMode reader at the running build's source treats an absent key as "separate" (MIGRATION-PLAN §3r settings-parity, D3) — behaviour-neutral. Allowed live ONLY as exactly "separate"; any other value, or the key in the export, is red.
